risk_note: RV2 (db migration, generated schema.sql / db.gen.ts). D10-316 ①, 08 BR-TEXT-20 detail (SMS channel registry) and 04 §3: notify_templates gains four nullable columns sms_sign_name, sms_template_code, sms_template_type (verify / notice) and sms_preview_text, all NULL (not registered) or all set, the text ones never blank (same non-whitespace class as body_override, written with \u escapes); notify_logs gains nullable sms_biz_id (Aliyun BizId), never blank and only on channel sms. Additive only: no backfill, existing rows, constraints, keys, indexes and grants unchanged (table-level grants cover the new columns); one migration file with validated ADD CONSTRAINT (notification tables are not funds tables, as 0044 / 0049 / 0069). Same migration (D10-337 ①, D10-339 ⑤, 04 §3) also stores the pending registration: sms_pending_sign_name / _template_code / _template_type / _preview_text, sms_test_status (accepted / failed / not_sent_no_verify_phone) and sms_tested_at, all six NULL or all set, text ones non-blank, independent of the four in-use columns. No credential column (AccessKey stays in deployment config). Frozen column-set tests of B1-12e / B1-12f / B1-12n gain only the new columns (approvals #24). No money, no attribution.
